card.name: Spots just before diet or fasting terms
card.fires_on: Spaces, commas and linking words (or, the, least) right before a number of hours or a diet name, in text about fasting, diets or dietary studies. It also fires on the gap before a year in citations within diet discussions.

modes.label: Fasting duration
modes.description: Gap or 'least' just before a number of hours or days of fasting or not eating.
modes.example: Fast for at least<< >>4 hours prior to administration.

modes.label: Diet name lists
modes.description: Linking word between or before named diets or diet types.
modes.example: when the Atkins or<< the>> South Beach diets came out

modes.label: Citations in diet text
modes.description: Space or comma before the year in a citation about vegetarian or diet effects.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like diet, dietary, vegetarian, fasting and restriction.
card.plain: It lights up where the text is about to say something about diet or fasting.
